visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final portable frames including the compact preview. Individual Moscow mosque: broad golden onion dome on a windowed drum, two tall stacked western minarets with octagonal turquoise window tiers and gilded conical caps, smaller gold and teal eastern turrets, pale cornices and parapets, grouped turquoise pointed fields and a projecting south gable. Corrected the gable glazing where cornice bands crossed the old surface. Replaced concave-ring parapet caps with separate edge bars to remove a triangle crossing the northern indentation. Current top views retain the clear U indentation. All heights, turret positions, internal plans and facade rhythms are picture estimates. Fine calligraphy, lattice artwork, fixtures and unseen interiors are omitted.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final shared/geographic-flat views including the north-up footprint overlay. Six existing shared 256² stucco, marble, raw limestone, standing-seam metal, cast bronze and plain wood graphs serve seven merged roles including local opaque turquoise glazing. Metric UVs, linear tints, low-frequency surfaces and zero embedded images. Every graph is read once; eviction leaves zero live model geometries. Original anchor and heading remain fixed. The exact nine-vertex U-shaped main outline is retained; the separate northern low building remains host content. Flat terrain verifies transforms and replacement, not precise ground contact.

fidelityReview.notes: Individual medium-fi modern main Moscow Cathedral Mosque: broad golden onion dome, two tall stepped minarets with gilded cones, smaller gold/teal corner turrets, pale multi-level body, nested tall turquoise pointed windows, cornice bands and simplified parapets. Raw main outline retained; all detailed plans and heights estimated from two pictures. Six existing shared 256² graphs, seven merged roles and four budgeted browser LODs. Separate northern low building, city, fine artwork and unseen interiors remain outside this asset. No retained or current mapped height values are available. Explicit visualization estimates: main body eaves 22 m, stepped central support 26 m, drum 28–35 m, broad golden onion 35–47 m and finial 50 m. Two western minarets rise from rectangular 31 m bases through stepped octagonal window tiers near 33–48, 50–61 and 63–69 m, to gilded cones at 78 m and finials at 80 m. Northeastern smaller gold turret top about 40 m; southeastern teal turret top about 34 m. Roof steps, minor teal caps, cornices, parapets and pointed gables are estimates. These are visualization dimensions, not surveyed facts. Fine calligraphy, lattice patterns, sculpture and unseen interiors omitted. Two actually inspected useful Commons pictures guide the gold/teal/pale massing and south gable. There are no current or retained height tags, independent roof/minaret parts or surveyed internal dimensions. Main eaves 22 m, stepped roof 26 m, drum to 35 m, dome to 47 m, central finial 50 m; western minaret finials 80 m, smaller gold and teal caps about 40/34 m are visualization estimates. The gabled bay projects about one metre south of the raw wall. Exact finish, facade ornament, hidden faces, engineering, furnished interiors and physical-device timing are unverified. Adjacent buildings, streets and city remain host content.
